caption:
Correction was never meant to condemn — it was meant to build love. (1 Timothy 1:3–5 devotional)

"Should I say this, or hold it in?" We treat truth and love like rivals. Paul says the goal of the command is love — from a pure heart, a good conscience, sincere faith.

True correction comes from love and moves toward love. The same blade does one thing in a surgeon's hand and another in an angry one.
